title: FastAPI Inventory
description: Full-stack inventory manager with product CRUD, stock restocking, and auto-seeded demo data.

techDetails.scope: Built to get hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL for the first time while learning Python and FastAPI from a YouTube playlist.
highlights: Pydantic v2 schemas for strict payload validation
Auto DB table creation & demo data seeding on startup

title: SpringMart
description: Full-stack e-commerce app with multi-field search, image byte uploads, and paginated catalogs.

techDetails.scope: Built to practice and apply Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and Docker containerization while learning from a YouTube playlist.
techDetails.architecture: Java • Spring Boot • Spring Data JPA • Docker • React
highlights: Custom JPQL search across name, description, brand & category
Raw byte image storage & Docker Compose setup

title: Student Management System
description: Terminal Java app for student record management, grade analytics, and SQL injection defense.

techDetails.scope: My very first coding project. Built to learn Java and MySQL, using AI tools for the first time to guide me through the architecture from start to finish.
highlights: Parameterized PreparedStatement queries against SQL injection
Grade distribution analytics and class performance reports

title: wrkout
description: Clean, lightweight workout tracker built for Push, Pull, Legs (PPL) training splits.

techDetails.scope: Built during a low phase when I was dealing with Class 1 obesity at 94 kg and had just joined the gym. I designed it around my PPL routine to build gym consistency, log workouts, and get that satisfying dopamine hit with every completed exercise.
highlights: Fast set logging with inline steppers & tactile feedback

title: Shreyan's Arc
description: Interactive DSA roadmap tracking 58 interview problems across 17 coding patterns.

techDetails.scope: When I started my DSA prep, I felt overwhelmed, confused, and stressed by the sheer number of LeetCode questions and roadmaps. After researching, I found NeetCode's Blind 75 and Sean Prashad's list, which inspired me to streamline the process. I built my own custom roadmap by comparing both resources and including only the most frequently asked, high-yield questions to cover crucial DSA patterns, helping me stay focused and practice with zero friction.
highlights: Interactive canvas to pan, zoom, and customize roadmap node layout
Google login to sync progress across multiple devices
58 handpicked interview questions across 17 essential DSA patterns

title: J-Void
description: Browser-based Java code editor built for distraction-free syntax practice.

techDetails.scope: I love clean, minimal software. I built J-Void because LeetCode's default editor felt cluttered with features I didn't need, giving me a distraction-free in-browser editor just for writing and practicing Java solutions.
highlights: Zero-setup Java practice editor with automatic Allman brace formatting
Custom line bookmarking inside the Monaco Editor gutter
Direct LeetCode problem links aligned with Shreyan's Arc

title: WealthWise
description: Financial planning platform featuring interactive investment and growth calculators.

techDetails.scope: Built for my father to help him grow his financial advisory business. It lets prospective clients explore services and run investment calculations before their consultation, saving time for both parties and streamlining lead capture.
highlights: Calculators for Investment, Retirement, Education & Marriage goals
Direct WhatsApp lead routing with customizable advisor branding
